_about: Agility (sea step 3d; rules: game/agility.gd, spots: core/shortcut_spots.gd). obstacles: a course obstacle's model (made by tools/blender/fantasy_props.py, crossed from its origin `length` metres along its facing), seconds to cross, lift = how high the body goes at most, profile flat | hops | over | swing (the path the body follows). courses: one per region, a place of kind course in data/fantasy/world.json: level needed, xp per obstacle, lap = bonus for every obstacle in order. fail: success chance = base + per_level x (your level - the course's), never above 1; a fall costs damage x max health and gives nothing (perk sure_foot halves the misses). shortcuts: cliffs found in every `cell` metres of open country (chance per cell) get a way up: ladder = must be mended first (Carpentry, recipe mend_ladder) and then anyone may climb, ledge_<n> = a knotted rope that needs Agility n. regions = which kinds a region's cliffs get; climb_seconds; xp per climb (Agility; a mended ladder gives Carpentry its recipe xp once). run_speed perks add percent to running in Aurelind and at sea. All numbers are placeholders for the director.
